title: Pelayo Solage
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at “Pelayo Solage”, a luxury 6-bed, 6 full & 1 half-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 16 guests, this home offers a Private Pool & Spa, Game Room, Elevator, & Golf Cart. Book your stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights - Deeded Beach and use rights to one mile of pristine shoreline - Large Outdoor living areas with gas grill - Fire Pit - Private Heated Pool & Spa (Pool can be heated for an additional $50 per day from October 1-May 1) - 6-Seater Golf Cart Included - 6 Bikes Included - Game/Media room - Elevator - Parking for 4 vehicles What sets Pelayo Solage apart is its extraordinary position within Gulf Shore Manor, one of the few neighborhoods along 30A that enjoys rights to over one mile of uninterrupted shoreline. With five deeded beach access points, guests experience a freedom that is nearly unheard of on 30A, easy access to the beach without parking hassles. Just a short walk to the emerald waters of Seagrove Beach, where mornings begin with quiet footprints in soft sand and evenings fade into unforgettable Gulf sunsets. Tucked into desirable Seagrove Beach and steps from the gulf, Pelayo Solage is the perfect blend of timeless architecture and modern coastal luxury. With 4,300+ sq ft of interior living space and an additional 1,500 sq ft of outdoor terraces and balconies, the home offers generous room to relax, entertain, and gather. Every detail inside has been meticulously crafted-from wide-plank hardwood floors, artisan tile and the chef’s kitchen completed with Viking appliances. Thoughtfully designed bathrooms evoke a spa-like atmosphere with serene, high-quality finishes. The outdoor living areas feel like a private resort. A heated pool and spa form the heart of the space surrounded by comfortable lounge seating, a fire pit, and a top-level terrace with sweeping views providing an ideal setting for sunset cocktails or quiet evening conversations. Indoors, the dedicated game and media room offers yet another inviting space for family time, move nights or casual entertaining. A six-seater low speed vehicle and complimentary bikes make it effortless to explore everything 30A offers, from Seaside’s iconic town center to scenic bike paths and beachside cafes. Pelayo Solage delivers a rare combination of coastal elegance, convenience, and tranquility in one of the Emerald Coast’s most coveted neighborhoods. Sleeping Arrangements First Floor King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom - Shower Only Second Floor Master King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom - Shower and Soaking Tub Queen Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom - Shower Only 2 Twin over Twin Bunkroom w/ Private Bathroom - Shower Tub Combo Queen Sleeper Sofa Third Floor King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom - Shower Only Jr Master King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom - Shower Only **Please note there is nearby construction**
